title: onboard aquila-8b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard 'aquila-8b' v1.0 into the model registry with canonical metadata, generated performance profiles, and updates to the changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: aquila-8b is part of the curated model catalog for Q4 and we need production-ready metadata + perf profiles so the serving runtime and Optimize tooling can make informed routing/quantization decisions. This PR contains: 1) model metadata: canonical metadata.yaml with model name, aliases, tokenizer, supported formats, recommended quantization profiles, and provenance (source, license, fingerprint). 2) perf profiles: CPU/GPU latency and throughput profiles for typical seq lengths (32/128/512), memory footprints, and KV-cache scaling; profiles are generated by the perf-profile-generator and validated against the perf harness. 3) changelog automation updates: extend the changelog generator to include a perf_profile summary block in the generated release notes for model onboards, and add a templated release_notes entry for model listings (used by the release pipeline). 4) CI/workflow: add unit tests for the perf-profile parser and a new GitHub Actions job that validates that onboarding PRs include the required metadata fields. Checklist: - [x] Add models/aquila-8b/v1.0/metadata.yaml - [x] Add perf-profiles/aquila-8b-v1.0.json - [x] Update registry/index.yaml to include new model entry - [x] Add perf profile unit tests - [x] Update .github/workflows/changelog.yml to render perf profile snippets - [x] Run perf harness and attach artifacts Context: perf-profile-generator was previously used interactively; this PR hooks its output into the registry CI and changelog pipeline so release notes show a short perf summary (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec at batch sizes) which helps SRE and sales when evaluating new models. Related: ENG-4421 (onboard plan), ENG-4478 (changelog automation). Notes: - The perf numbers were produced on rtx-a100-40gb instances in the benchmark lab; raw artifacts are attached to the PR build. - Perf profile fields use matched units (ms for latency, tok/s for throughput, GiB for memory). - The changelog generator adds a small human-readable paragraph under the model section; longer tables are kept in artifacts to avoid cluttering release notes. Merge strategy: squash and merge.

Priya Nair: Perf numbers look reasonable. Please confirm units in the JSON (ms / tok/s). Also add a short note about measurement hardware in the perf profile metadata.
Maya Chen: Added hardware_info to perf profile and a comment in docs/models/aquila-8b.md about harness configuration.
Evan Liu: CI job looks good but please ensure the GitHub Action runs only on model-registry paths to avoid extra runs. Recommend adding a path filter.

discussion_summary: Reviewer feedback focused on provenance details, explicit units in perf profiles, and a small GH Actions filter to limit runs. All requested changes were made and verified in CI.

notes: This PR is part of the Q4 model catalog refresh (ENG-4421). The changelog automation piece will be used by the upcoming release pipeline to include concise perf summaries in release notes.
human_summary: Onboards aquila-8b v1.0 with metadata and perf profiles, and wires perf-profile outputs into the changelog/release-notes generator; includes CI checks and unit tests to validate onboarding completeness.
